days.title: Eastern Access and High Pastures
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Pinea
stops.detail: From Salbertrand: by car you go directly to the Pinea equipped area, with parking.

stops.name: Alpe Arguel
stops.detail: From Susa and Chiomonte: to Pian del Frais, then Alpe Arguel via a dirt road or via Clot Rosset and by dirt road towards Clot Rosset/Clot des Anes.

days.title: Western Gateways and Forest Areas
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Monfol
stops.detail: Alternatively, you can get off at Oulx station and use the connecting shuttle to Sauze d'Oulx: from here, you reach the hamlet of Monfol on foot, where the protected area's signage begins.

stops.name: Ser Blanc
stops.detail: The first is reached by proceeding from the town center towards the hamlet of Gran Villard and, having passed this and entered the municipality of Oulx, proceeding into the park where it is possible to travel by car through Monfol (a hamlet of Oulx) until the Ser Blanc equipped area.

stops.name: Enfers
stops.detail: The second is reached by proceeding from the town center towards the hamlet of Richardette towards the SP 173 of the Colle dell'Assietta until the locality of Enfers from where it is permitted to enter the Park by car up to the prohibition signs placed inside the woods.
